scope:
v3.2.1 economy integration. Executes shipping PLAY.html in Chromium memory;
only the existing diagnostic access guard is enabled. Keyboard, DOM, input, renderer,
serialization, import/export and simulation are the actual application. Controlled
clocks/cards are fixtures, not human play or certified HTTP/platform testing.

tests.name: The shipped HTML contains the new economy module and correct ruleset
Fresh campaign renders zero books and exactly two capacity pips per spell
The first five actual card opportunities contain no tutorial resource flood
The sixth card must be typed to earn ICE, with the preserved glow and readiness feedback
A scarce ICE charge still quick-casts for six seconds without losing typed selection
Chapter-one spawn schedule contains one spell, not all four
Third pickup awards word points but cannot create a third charge or pip
Capacity pips decrement correctly and an active recast does not waste the remaining charge
All four spell strengths and ICE/SLOW queuing remain unchanged
Next chapter carries the countdown and unused books rather than restarting the gift schedule
Trial puts an earned opportunity in its first wave and every eight cards, with no free charges
FIRE cannot farm replacement spells or reset the sparse schedule
Pause and resume preserve the economy counter and partial word
Retry reproduces the same sixth-card reward and cannot keep failed-attempt score or stock
Practice retains its separately scored training kit, without a campaign tutorial reset
Endless keeps its independent starter kit and continues the late speed curve
Endless trials use the same earned first-wave opportunities without extra free stock
Real spawned cards use the approved gentle-opening and late-chapter speeds
How to play communicates the actual two-charge limit without extra screen clutter
Actual file import keeps prior scores in Legacy and migrates 3.2 books into the two-charge cap
Continuing a migrated run uses the new economy while retaining Legacy scoring provenance
Real save export includes the sparse schedule and correct build version
New game after migration starts empty under current scoring rules
A new empty campaign cannot inherit a previous run’s acquisition glow
Spending the last book clears acquisition glow while retaining the ACTIVE indicator
No unhandled JavaScript exceptions in the economy/browser audit
